metadata.title: The Open Doors of a Dark-Energy-Tied Galaxy Law: Scoped No-Gos, Record Corrections, and a Cassini Failure of the Unscreened Law (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.0 (2026-10-22). AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed.

The owner's programme studies a gravity framework whose galactic law is g_N = g^2/(g + a0), a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_DE), with kappa = 1/2 fitted; its extra gravitating mass is a collisionless 'cold energy' medium, not a particle. This note reports one rigorous pass (the 2026-10-22 'doors push') over every door the record had left open. Every lane froze its criteria before computing and ran a mutation control; both a0 footings (9.36e-11 and 1.13e-10 m/s^2) are reported and never pooled. Most results are scoped no-gos and corrections to the record.

(1) kappa is not derived: no horizon-thermodynamic monomial gives 1/2 without square roots, and with them 1/2 appears only as sqrt(G rho_Lambda) times a hand-picked half; the class's natural output is Milgrom's a0 = cH_Lambda/2pi (arXiv:1605.07458), a postulate here. The record's claim that the data select R = 4 among natural caps is wrong (5 of 7 grid values lie within 2 sigma). (2) The unscreened canonical law fails Cassini Q2 by 1.7-4x (1.70-3.70 canonical, 1.91-4.03 alternative, against the Hees et al. 2014 2-sigma line), and the strong-field turn-off moves Q2 by at most 0.052 sigma, so it cannot help; no member of the record's unscreened law family passes both Q2 and SPARC on both footings (weakest tension 2.6 sigma); this is the RAR-Q2 class conflict of Desmond, Hees and Famaey (2024). The screened case is a separate lane (D7d), pending. The turn-off has no mechanism in the action and its scale y_t is kappa relabelled. (3) The stiffness length L* survives only as a tethered-state property; dwarf HI dispersions are not set by star formation but are not one universal number, and read as a floor they put L* below the globular-cluster bound. (4) No covariant parent: Gauss-enforcing U(1)-dielectric parents are superluminal or need a dark-sector Lorentz violation of 6.3e7 at 1 AU; enforcing the identity in the record's healthy action restores the no-self-gravity theorem. (5) The skew-sign test of the law's form is retired; the wide-binary fork is decided by systematics, not by N, and the wide-binary kappa leverage is 0.121 -> 0.077, not 0.0605; the two sealed ALMA tests are expected to be unscorable; the native 1024^3 shear run died of memory with no verdict. (6) No tested mechanism gives the record's retained fraction u = 0.47 inside splashback: the record's cluster model gives u = 0, inflow stream counting gives 0.50 but is rejected by the profile (chi2 39.0 for 8 dof), and isolated-galaxy lensing gives u >= 0.66, so u is not universal. Six errata were written fix-forward into the record.

Pending at v1.0: Cassini Q2 of the screened theory (lane D7d). Not derived: kappa = 1/2, L*, eta/gamma, the retained fraction. Companion notes: PAPER49 v1.2 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23533323), PAPER55 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23482936), PAPER56 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23532875), PAPER57 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23532885). AI assistance: Anthropic's Claude (analysis lanes, review, drafting).
